title: 23 supplier links declare location ENTSO (registered as ENTSO-E); two declare CH for GLO/RER suppliers
observation: 23 exchanges declare the supplier location `ENTSO`; no dataset is registered as ENTSO, 25 as ENTSO-E, and every one of the 23 suppliers exists as ENTSO-E. Two more exchanges declare `CH` for suppliers that exist only as GLO / RER (`Disposal, concrete, 5% water, to inert material landfill`; `Direct air capture system, sorbent-based, 100ktCO2`). An importer linking by name + location drops all 25 silently; one linking by dataset number does not.
method: Re-measured on the release files by the reporter's side, not by a second person; the patch changes a location only when a supplier with the new location exists.

answer.summary: BAFU confirmed the 25 supplier locations and said it will correct them in its next release.

next.action: Verify the 25 locations in the next BAFU release; then record the correction and retire patch 0002. F14 and F16 are the same class but not part of patch 0002.
